summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of visual-first recipe display in chat. All features working correctly: login flow, chat page with greeting, mood message sending, AI recipe suggestions with visual cards, high-quality images, and Save Recipe functionality.

issues: Recipe card titles sometimes show section headers like 'Instructions:', 'Nutritional Highlights:', 'Sensory Descriptions:' instead of actual recipe names - this is due to AI response parsing

Chat page loads with initial greeting message
User can send a mood message (e.g., 'I'm feeling stressed')
Recipe suggestions display with visual cards (image + text layout)

Save Recipe button works on recipe cards
